mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_diet_scores (user_id, date, score, feedback) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{score}, #{feedback}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), feedback = VALUES(feedback), created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userId, date, score, feedback, created_at as createdAt FROM daily_diet_scores WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date}
